items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Then, uh, I forgot about Walter Barnes. Mmhmm. He was coming in.

ctx.x: Belton? That's entirely new to me. I never heard of him before in my life. Belton. Belton. Featuring T Hound Slim.

That's the second big band invented here. T what? T Hound Slim, that's the first. T Hound Slim? Yeah, he used to dance and singing. Dance in front of the band. That's all, let's dance. Mmhmm. Then I forgot about Walter Barnes. Mmhmm. He was coming in. Then, uh, Nat Tolles started coming. Mmhmm. Nat Tolles.
